messages:
kevin: Heads-up: we crossed 10M monthly requests this morning 🎉 Small in-person java & cake at 11:30 in the lounge? Quick five-minute cheers?
sophia: WHAT!! omg yes. I'll bring coffee. Also can we get a tiny cake that says "10M"?
rui: I'll whip up a tiny banner. Also shoutout thread for product and support please.
ops-bot: metrics-bot: current month requests: 10,012,437; 24h peak 1.2M; no active incidents ✅
anya: mini poll: cake or cookies? Reply with "cake" or "cookies"
kevin: cake please. (cookies are for crises)
sophia: cake
rui: cookies (I like cookies)
anya: cake wins by vote 2-1. Ordering chocolate cake + gf slice.
design-bot: Uploaded a quick badge: https://internal.example.com/assets/10m-badge.png — feel free to use on internal posts.
kevin: Reminder: please use "milestone: 10M requests" phrasing if posting internally. No customer names in public posts per comms.
sophia: I'll post a quick note in #announcements-internal after 11:45. Copy: "Team hit 10M monthly requests — huge thanks to infra, runtime, and support. Short celebration in the lounge at 11:30." Approvals?
rui: +1. Love the messaging.
ops-bot: lounge booked 11:20-11:40. Please keep it quick.
kevin: Remote folks: we'll do a group photo and drop in #team-photos. If you're remote and want a sticker, DM me.
anya: I'll bring the confetti poppers (office-safe) and extra napkins.
sophia: GIF: :partyparrot:
rui: Also, anyone up for a mini 30s karaoke of our victory song?
kevin: Only if we limit it to 30s and no interpretive dance.
ops-bot: nightly-backup: snapshot completed at 03:05 UTC — systems healthy.
design-bot: Announce draft posted in #announcements-drafts for comms approval.
kevin: Thanks everyone — see you at 11:30. Drop a clap emoji if you're coming.
sophia: 👏
rui: 👏
anya: 👏 (and gluten-free slice labeled)
